# Domain Allowlist - never added to FQDN_list.txt by auto-fetch
#
# Matching: exact domain, or any subdomain (foo.example.com matches example.com)
#
# Only list providers that control their own subdomains. Do NOT list
# user-content platforms (blogspot.com, github.io, web.app, firebaseapp.com,
# amazonaws.com, blob.core.windows.net) - attackers control subdomains there
# and those entries must stay blockable.
